device.description: 16-bit 200 kSPS low-power sampling ADC with internal reference, byte-wide parallel and serial outputs
device.note: ads8517.pdf (SLAS527A) p.3-4 specifications (conversion time 2.5 us, VIH 0.5 VDIG, data coding, VDIG 1.65-5.5 V, bus access/relinquish 83 ns), p.4 Table 1 input ranges, p.5-6 pin configuration and assignments, p.14 starting a conversion and Table 2, p.15 reading data, Tables 3-4 and parallel output, p.16 Figures 30-31, p.17 Table 5 parallel timing

commands.name: Convert (CS and R/C low)
commands.note: p.14 Table 2: CS falling with R/C low, or R/C falling with CS low, initiates conversion N; convert commands are ignored while BUSY is low

pages: p.3 (conversion time 2.5 us max), p.4 (VIH 0.5xVDIG to VDIG+0.3 V, binary two's complement or straight binary, bus access / relinquish 83 ns, VDIG 1.65-5.5 V; Table 1 input ranges), p.5-6 (pin configuration DW/PW, pin assignments), p.14 (Table 2 parallel control functions), p.15 (Table 4: SB 0 V = 8000h / BTC 0000h on +/-10 V; parallel output: BYTE low = 8 MSBs on D7-D0, high = 8 LSBs), p.17 (Table 5: t9 bus relinquish 83 ns max)
notModeled: analog inputs, input-range resistor network (R1IN/R2IN wiring, Table 1), internal reference (REF output, REFD shuts it down) and CAP buffer

codeFormat assumes the +/-10 V range (first in Table 1): SB/BTC high gives straight binary with 0 V = 8000h (offset), low two's complement (0000h). On the unipolar 0-5 V / 0-4 V ranges 0 V is -full scale, which the model does not give
serial output (SDATA, DATACLK internal/external clock per EXT/INT, TAG daisy-chain input): only the parallel port (EXT/INT high, DATACLK low) is modeled; SDATA and DATACLK are never driven

the conversion starts when the CS/R/C low period ends (write access end) rather than at its falling edge; the 40 ns - 5 us convert pulse and the rule that CS or R/C must be high when BUSY rises are not checked

reading during a conversion returns the previous result (valid up to t11 after the start); power-up contents of the parallel output are indeterminate (model: the 0 V code); the first conversion after power-up is invalid
PWRD (conversions inhibited, results kept) is not read; VDIG <= VANA; acquisition time and throughput limits
